_what: accession -> gene symbol, accumulated across runs, so the probe->symbol bridge is built once rather than on every CI job.
_why: The platforms and series this resolves are immutable; rebuilding the map cost 30.8 of a 33-minute job and lost accuracy whenever a remote endpoint degraded.
\u26d4_successes_only: An accession that failed to resolve is NOT recorded. A remote outage must not become a permanent finding that an accession has no gene.
